what: terminal export of an append-only transparency log
proves: that these leaf bytes, in this order, produce the final root
that the log key signed that root at this size
that the listed witnesses cosigned the same root from size 250 onward - the 41 anchored checkpoints below that size carry no cosignature and rest on the log's own key alone
that any receipt naming an index <= final_tree_size can be rechecked against this frozen tree

that every anchored checkpoint in anchors/ is a prefix of these exact leaves - its root equals the recomputed root at its own stated size, under a verifying log signature - so the whole anchored history is tied to these bytes rather than only the final head

that every cosignature in anchors/ names a verifier key shipped inside this bundle - 5997 Ed25519 lines against witness_keys.json and 1660 ML-DSA-44 lines against pq_keys.json - so nothing here needs a network, or our word, to check
does_not_prove: that the recorded claims are true
that the log was complete (nothing withheld)
that the log key belonged to any particular operator - key-to-identity binding is a social fact this bundle freezes but cannot establish
